criteria.detail: The sole repair agent's brief explicitly requires filing the catalyst-system incident 'as part of this cycle,' so no incident is deferred to a later dispatch.
The actor states the fresh repair meta-agent writes the incident in the kit tree and that 'the orchestrator never writes incidents.'

judge_reasoning: The dispatch bundles the incident into the single repair meta-agent's cycle, and the actor explicitly assigns authorship to that fresh meta-agent rather than the orchestrator; both criteria pass.
